principles: fail-closed before phase mutation: lock contention must stop before phase=DONE is written
explicit operator recovery: merging a partial-DONE branch back to main is too important to hide inside generic doctor --repair
single critical section: DONE preflight through merge/worktree cleanup must be serialized by one shared lock
truth-source sync: new operator-facing lifecycle commands must update story-lifecycle docs
drivers: B-9027 produced a real partial-DONE after concurrent main merge activity
cross-story/team usage makes main a shared mutable resource
operators need a safe command that replaces handwritten git merge/worktree/branch cleanup

options.name: A: done-main-merge lock + doctor detection + explicit done_recover command
pros: prevents future concurrent DONE races before phase mutation
doctor can surface partial-DONE status without mutating main
done_recover provides an explicit, auditable recovery action with safety checks
cons: requires smoke coverage for both lock and recovery

options.name: B: only add lock, no recovery command
pros: smaller change and directly prevents future races
cons: does not help already partial-DONE stories like B-9027
operators still need handwritten git commands when recovery is needed

options.name: C: extend doctor --repair to merge partial-DONE automatically
cons: doctor --repair currently cleans residual worktrees; automatically merging branches into main is a larger mutation and too implicit
harder for users to see exactly which story will merge

chosen: A: done-main-merge lock + doctor detection + explicit done_recover command
rationale: Choose A. The lock closes the actual race before phase=DONE is written, doctor detection makes partial-DONE visible, and an explicit done_recover command gives operators a deliberate, auditable way to complete merge/worktree/branch cleanup. B is incomplete because it leaves current partial-DONE states manual. C hides a high-risk main merge behind generic doctor --repair, which is too implicit for a shared repository.

preMortem.scenario: Lock is acquired too late, after autoSyncMain or phase=DONE has already mutated state
preMortem.trigger: Developer wraps only runDonePreMergeGate/applyDoneMergeEffects but leaves checkMainDivergence/autoSyncMain outside the lock
preMortem.consequence: Two DONE operations can still race while syncing/merging main, recreating partial-DONE or branch drift
preMortem.mitigation: Acquire lock before the existing DONE divergence check at story-advance.ts line ~149; smoke holds lock and asserts no autoSync/phase mutation occurs

preMortem.scenario: Stale lock blocks all future DONE forever
preMortem.consequence: Every subsequent DONE is refused and operators are stuck
preMortem.mitigation: Use withMkdirLock stale reclaim semantics and include holder metadata/retry text; smoke creates stale lock and asserts reclaim

preMortem.scenario: done_recover merges unsafe branch into dirty main
preMortem.trigger: Recovery ignores main dirty state or merge-tree conflicts
preMortem.consequence: Operator loses unrelated work or creates bad merge
preMortem.mitigation: Fail closed unless main is safe for affected paths, branch exists, merge-base/merge-tree checks pass, and worktree/branch match storyId

preMortem.scenario: doctor reports partial-DONE false positives for ordinary DONE cleanup leftovers
preMortem.trigger: Detector treats any terminal worktree residue as partial-DONE even when branch already merged
preMortem.consequence: Operator sees noisy recovery warnings and loses trust
preMortem.mitigation: Detector separates terminal worktree residue from partial-DONE: partial-DONE requires phase DONE plus branch/worktree residue plus main not containing branch or cleanup incomplete

preMortem.scenario: new done_recover behavior ships without lifecycle documentation
preMortem.trigger: Code adds operator-facing recovery command but story-lifecycle.md still tells users to do manual git recovery
preMortem.consequence: Agents keep using handwritten recovery steps and miss the new safe path
preMortem.mitigation: Update docs/requirements/decisions/story-lifecycle.md in CHK-004 and verify docs mention doctor partial-DONE output plus done_recover
